AiTwin.Error.Title: AI Twin is not available

AiTwin.Error.TechnicalDetails.Hint: Verify the Creatio system setting {{ setting }}. It must contain the published AI Twin chat remoteEntry.json URL. Current app builds no longer use a federation manifest.
AiTwin.ConfirmEmail.Title: Confirm your email address
AiTwin.ConfirmEmail.Description: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Open the message and follow the link to verify your address. Once you've confirmed it, select Continue. Didn't get the email? Select Resend link to send it again.
AiTwin.ConfirmEmail.ResentNote: A new confirmation email has been sent.
